tex_content.html:
Theorem
[Every subgroup of a free group is free]

↗ prop:covering-space-existence-for-subgroup ↗ prop:covering-map-pi1-injective ↗ lem:covering-space-of-graph-is-graph ↗ prop:fundamental-group-of-graph-is-free 1. ch1:1A.4\group Covering Spaces

Every subgroup of a free group is free.

Proof

\sketch Realize the free group as the fundamental group of a wedge of circles. The subgroup construction gives a covering graph whose fundamental group is the subgroup by covering injectivity. The graph proposition makes that fundamental group free.

□
